label: scam
title: SSA impersonation -- suspended number, gift cards

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the Social Security Administration. Your number has been suspended due to suspicious activity.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To reactivate it and avoid arrest you must verify funds by purchasing $500 in gift cards today.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not discuss this with anyone, it is a federal matter.
